responsibility: Contains the MSP430 machine description used by GCC’s RTL expander, recognizer, and instruction selector. It defines target UNSPEC codes, instruction attributes and length calculations, mode/code iterators, and the full set of RTL patterns and expansions for MSP430 instructions, including moves, branches, shifts, prologue/epilogue-related forms, and hardware-multiply expansions that either emit inline sequences or call MSPABI helpers. This file is the primary source of target instruction semantics and encoding choices.
same_name_distinction: This is the machine-description file for MSP430 RTL patterns, attributes, iterators, and instruction expansions used by recognition and instruction selection. Unlike msp430.cc it is declarative pattern data rather than general C++ backend logic, unlike msp430.h it is not macro-based target configuration, and unlike msp430.opt it does not define user options.
